scientific_integrity: The all-size counting formula is proved combinatorially; the sharp finite cutoff uses a complete isomorphism-free tree census and independent direct one-point-profile checks. All supplied coefficients and witnesses were recomputed.
scientific_limitations: The exhaustive isomorphism and polynomial census is for height-two posets with tree Hasse cover and orders at most ten. A relevant 1980 insertion-position article was accessible at abstract level only. No claim is made for arbitrary posets, larger orders, or independent historical priority certification.
title: Sharp ten-vertex collisions of graded one-point types over height-two tree-cover posets
